notes.title: designmatic @ gamescom 2025
notes.notes: [p]We are going to attend gamescom 2025 and are part of the Creative Europe Media stand. You can find the EU stand at Hall 3.2 D050g/F051g.[/p][p][/p][p]People will be able to try out new features we have been working on for the first time. We continue to work on them and prepare a new public demo on Steam that will focus on combat and boss fights.[/p][p] [/p][p]Again, thank you all so much for your support and feedback so far.[/p]

notes.title: Games Forged in Germany
notes.notes: [p]We are part of the Games Forged in Germany event![/p][p][/p][p]You can try out our Demo #1, which received several updates incorporating community feedback. Let us know what you think about the game when you try out the demo for the first time. This first demo focuses entirely on the platforming aspects of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime we are hard at work for bringing you folks the first look of our game's combat system. [/p]

notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.2.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed ledge snap getting triggered when not needed, which now results in a much more fluid movement feeling during platforming. It should now be triggered when its actually needed to reach a platform / ledge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wall collider to prevent wall jumps on it that leads to exiting level bounds in flower platform section of the demo[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Graphics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved performance by implementing a multi-threaded graphics render commands pipeline that reduces CPU load on the main thread[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented ability to change display resolution in addition to upscaling options (DLSS, FSR, and STP)[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to set maximum FPS to limit FPS to a custom choice (can be useful to preserve battery life on a notebook)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved graphics performance by reducing graphics memory usage of several GB without a loss of visual fidelity [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added loading spinner for warm up screen to indicate the game is working on compiling the shaders[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added UI volume slider to adjust user interface (UI) related audio loudness[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded audio volume sliders to go to 150% loudness from previous maximum 100% to allow for more personalized options as well as improving accessibility for users that require it[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.1.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Graphics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed majority of DX12 shader stutter by introducing a shader compilation step when the game is started. Not all shaders can be pre warmed as of now due to a limitation by the used game engine (Unity)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected gamepad prompt icons for Nintendo Switch Pro Controller to be shown correctly for gameplay prompts[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.0.1
notes.notes: [p][b]Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Checkpoints restore all of player's life[/p][/*][*][p]Added wall jump blocker to level segment (first key pick-up area) to limit wall jumps that visuals match with level boundaries[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Graphics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Implemented a check if the game is running on a Steam Deck and uses new recommended default values that enables FSR2 upscaling by default[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Depth of Field (DoF) effect in the foreground of the player and it is only used in the background now[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance by optimizing water rendering settings[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Unity STP upscaler to have the same rendering injection point as DLSS and FSR to ensure same upscaling behavior[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed start buttons not being tinted and thus indicating focus is set on them for the game start screen as well as demo start screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added slope slide down controls hint to make sure players know how to accelerate and slow down while on slopes[/p][/*][*][p]Speed up of dialog text characters appearing in dialogs with NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Preparations for control rebindings functionality by introducing a new controls sub tab menu UI setup[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed SFX volume slider in audio settings having no effect and it now correctly lowers sound effects loudness[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest — Summary
notes.notes: [p]Steam Next Fest is officially over and we want to thank everyone who wishlisted or tried our demo out! The community feedback we received on Steam and Discord was just amazing. You took so much time to provide very helpful feedback and we are super grateful for that. We read all of it and are working on improving the game based on it![/p][p][/p][p]We reached the incredible wishlist milestone of over 4000 wishlists with your help. We cannot put in words how much that means to all of us![/p][p][/p][p]The road ahead is simple: We focus on delivering the next key part of the game, which is the combat system into the hands of our community. We also want to get a reality check, if the combat mechanics we are working on are good or what feels off.[/p][p][/p][p]With respect to Demo #1 we are happy with the warm reception and we will leave it up even after Steam Next Fest is over that more people can try it out. With Demo #2 we will offer a selection menu to quickly test out the different demos.[/p][p][/p][p]In the near future we will push updates to Demo #1 that will fix the most annoying issue with it, namely the DX12 shader compilation stutter. This should resolve a lot of performance issues encountered by people.[/p][p][/p][p]Things we already fixed with released minor hot fixes for Demo #1 based on community feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Added monitor display modes[/p][/*][*][p]Added toggle to enable and disable V-Sync[/p][/*][*][p]Added DLSS and FSR upscaling options[/p][/*][*][p]Ground dash has no cooldown anymore besides the time the dash execution itself[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced player jump input buffering to make jumps feel more responsive[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are hard at work to bring you Demo #2 to gather your insightful feedback again. Also, to fix fundamental performance issues for the game and add more requested setting options. The next minor update will include the following community requested fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Removed Depth of Field (DoF) effect in the foreground of the player and it will only be used in the background now[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoints restore all of player's life[/p][/*][*][p]Speed up of dialog text characters appearing in dialogs with NPCs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please make sure to follow the store page to see the news when we launch new updates and content! Again, thank you so much for your support and feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest — Demo Available
notes.notes:
You will be able to play Ayna: Shattered Truth for the first time during the next edition of Steam Next Fest!

Mark your calendars and do not miss your chance to get your first impression of the game from June 9th to 16th. This demo focuses only on the core movement and platforming aspects of the game. We want your feedback about them and see what parts need improvements.

For the future ahead we plan to utilize playtests to also gather feedback from the community for other parts of the game! We take the unusual approach to involve the community early on to make sure we are on the right track with the game.

Again, thank you so much for your support. Spreading the word about the game and seeing more people get excited about it feels just unreal.

notes.title: Reception of Game Reveal and GDC 2025
notes.notes:
Two weeks after the game announcement we are happy to report we received already over 1300 wishlists for the game. We want to thank everyone who spread the word about the game and the super lovely comments about it! The three biggest regions for the wishlists are China, USA, and Germany. As a result, we aim to translate the store page into more languages very soon to reach more people.

We had the pleasure to attend GDC 2025 in-person with several team members. During this trip several people got the chance to try Ayna: Shattered Truth for the first time. The reception was very good and exceeded expectations from several of them when trying out the game.

Our goal is to include the community very early on in the development cycle to make sure we get things right and do not overlook major issues in the game. As a result, keep an eye on our social media channels  or here on Steam as you might get surprised how soon you will be able to get your hands on Ayna: Shattered Truth to try it yourself.

Again, thank you all so much for your support and we are just getting started!

notes.title: Introducing Ayna: Shattered Truth
notes.notes:
We welcome everyone who is interested in Ayna: Shattered Truth. It is a game dear to our hearts and this love for it hopefully shows already in the published teaser trailer as well as screenshots.

We will share a lot more information about the game in the future and cannot wait to show you what cool unique gameplay things we have yet to announce.

In the meantime, please check out the official reveal teaser trailer and make sure to wishlist Ayna: Shattered Truth.

Finally, we also want to thank everyone for the kind words and warm reception of our game announcement.
